nodes.label: ① session starts

nodes.doc: the subether mod, on each tool call and each prompt the person types; the agent, when the person says something a later session needs or puts work off
nodes.label: during · calls and prompts

nodes.doc: the subether mod's session.end handler, under a 1.5 s budget
nodes.label: ② session ends

nodes.doc: right after a take, when serve encodes the episode
nodes.label: ③ after the take

nodes.doc: any time after, when serve consolidates a bank's traces
nodes.label: ④ later

nodes.doc: once a week, when no job has work and at least five model runs followed the last review
nodes.label: ⑤ weekly

nodes.doc: the seed: writes the start mark first, whatever follows, then prints the instructions, what is due, the always-set and the first prompt's matches
nodes.label: ① sandman recall

nodes.doc: writes start and end marks and a guard per denied tool call today; not built yet: one line per tool call or typed prompt, once recall and take write start and end
nodes.label: sandman mark

nodes.doc: the agent's write: one trace at once, homed as encode homes one; recall lists it at once, marked ~, the episode's encode takes it as already remembered, consolidate as any trace
nodes.label: sandman remember

nodes.doc: ignores a session with no start mark; skips, holds for a job, finds it gone, or renames the transcript into the archive; marks the end with its outcome; serve's tick takes a held one once its job is gone, and ends one that never ran take
nodes.label: ② sandman take

nodes.doc: serve's tick, one episode at a time: skips a headless one, else a headless model (Claude Opus by default, $SANDMAN_ENCODER so a local model can replace it) reads the archived transcript's digest, what the session already remembered listed as done, and writes its traces, a memory for the bank of the repository it is about, else the cwd's, a knowledge page or playbook for its topic; flagged so it is never taken or encoded itself
nodes.label: ③ serve · encode

nodes.doc: serve's tick, one quiet bank at a time when no episode waits: a headless model ($SANDMAN_CONSOLIDATOR) reads the bank's traces and memories, or a topic's traces and knowledge pages, and answers keep, merge or prune per trace and prune per memory; applied with no approval, everything it replaces moved to .pruned/; it takes the place of the dream pass
nodes.label: ④ serve · consolidate

nodes.doc: serve's tick, the weekly review: a headless model ($SANDMAN_REFLECTOR) reads the guidance in force and what encode, consolidate and recall did since, and may propose new guidance for encode or consolidate; recent inputs replay under the old and the new, a judge compares each pair blind, and a proposal the old never beats is adopted, the old kept under .history/; two failed runs after an adoption roll it back
nodes.label: ⑤ serve · reflect

nodes.doc: the agent's, when the person puts work off (later, tomorrow, after X): writes one intention, due a date or after an event; due lists it, done or drop closes it; nothing acts on one, the seed surfaces it
nodes.label: sandman defer · due · done

nodes.doc: the privacy ending: erases one session from every store for good, the ledger first, and records nothing naming it; what a merge folded in stays
nodes.label: sandman forget

nodes.doc: archived transcripts, <HHMMSS>-…-<session>.jsonl in a day dir
nodes.label: .archive/claude/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/

nodes.doc: every mod event, one per line, by UTC day: start, end, guard, call, prompt (today start, end and guard); and the daemon's encode, consolidate and reflect
nodes.label: ledger/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>.jsonl

nodes.doc: the long-term store's episodic part, filed by repository: memory files with flat frontmatter, <type>_<slug>.md
nodes.label: memories/<bank>/<file>.md

nodes.doc: the long-term store's semantic and procedural part, filed by topic: knowledge pages and playbooks, each revised in place as later episodes add to it
nodes.label: knowledge/<topic>/<file>.md

nodes.doc: newly encoded or remembered memories, still labile, awaiting consolidation, one dir per bank, a topic's as @<topic>, apart from the banks: <type>_<slug>.md
nodes.label: traces/<bank>/<file>.md

nodes.doc: what consolidate moved aside, recoverable: consumed traces, merged and pruned memories as they stood, each reply
nodes.label: .pruned/<yyyy>/<mm>/<dd>/

nodes.doc: the model jobs' guidance, read when present, else the default built in; written only by reflect, every replaced version under .history/; the contracts stay in the binary
nodes.label: prompts/<job>.md

nodes.doc: this machine's id, minted once from /dev/urandom; $SANDMAN_MACHINE overrides it
nodes.label: machine

nodes.doc: prospective memory: work the person deferred, one file each, due a date from the local today or after an event; open until done or dropped, never closed on its own
nodes.label: intentions/<id>.md

nodes.doc: reads the root, never writes it (bar the machine id)
nodes.label: sandman chart

nodes.doc: draws active, taken and memories as a timeline
nodes.label: bifrost · pipeline
